findings.current: — Your Sinews and Bones and your Meridians improve greatly!
findings.defect: The translation conflates and misnames two distinct System attributes: 근골 is Muscles and Bones, while 근맥 is Sinews and Meridians.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly raises two separate attributes, both of which have established glossary renderings.
findings.replacement: — Your Muscles and Bones and your Sinews and Meridians improve greatly!

findings.current: “Guo of the Three Paths Sect presents his respects.”[^1]
findings.defect: Both the surname and sect name conflict with established terminology. 곽 is Gwak, and 삼도문 is the Samdo Sect.
findings.rationale: The speaker is Gwak Jun, and the supplied glossary mandates Samdo Sect. The current Chinese-style surname rendering also breaks continuity with his later introduction.
findings.replacement: “Gwak of the Samdo Sect presents his respects.”[^1]

findings.defect: The named item is rendered with a different, generic name instead of its established title.
findings.rationale: 열화신단 has the exact glossary rendering Blazing Flame Divine Pill.

findings.current:
I started counting again from the end, one person at a time. Not counting me, there were eight. Han Yeop had serious injuries, so he obviously couldn’t have come—but Hyuk Mujin had snuck out to join us.

“…What are you doing here?”
findings.defect: The translation replaces Taekyung’s calculation with the answer before he identifies Hyuk Mujin. It omits that the original squad had nine members besides Taekyung, that both Hyuk Mujin and Han Yeop should be absent, and that only seven should therefore be present.
findings.rationale: The source builds the reveal through a numerical discrepancy. Naming Hyuk Mujin before Taekyung recognizes him removes that mechanism and prematurely resolves the surprise.
findings.replacement:
I started counting again from the end, one person at a time. There had originally been nine of them, excluding me. Hyuk Mujin and Han Yeop were both seriously injured, so neither should have been here. That meant there should have been seven, but…

“…What are you doing here?”
findings.source:
나는 끝에서부터 한 명씩 다시 세기 시작했다. 일단 나를 제외하고 아홉 명. 거기에 혁무진과 한엽은 중상이니까 당연히 오지 못했을 테니 일곱이 되어야 하는데…….

“……너 여기서 뭐 하냐?”

findings.current: More than five hundred martial artists stood in formation across the main training ground.
findings.defect: The established location name is replaced by a generic description.
findings.rationale: 대연무장 has the exact glossary rendering Grand Training Ground.
findings.replacement: More than five hundred martial artists stood in formation across the Grand Training Ground.
findings.source: 대연무장에 도열한 무사들의 숫자는 오백이 넘어갔다.

findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin’s established form of address is changed from Captain to Squad Leader.
findings.rationale: The glossary explicitly establishes 조장 as Captain when Hyuk Mujin addresses Taekyung, making this a hierarchy and address inconsistency.

findings.current: “I’m Gwak Jun of the Three Paths Sect. We met once before… We even shook hands.”
findings.defect: The established sect name is mistranslated.
findings.rationale: 삼도문 has the exact glossary rendering Samdo Sect, and the organization is central to the ensuing betrayal.
findings.replacement: “I’m Gwak Jun of the Samdo Sect. We met once before… We even shook hands.”
findings.source: “삼도문의 곽준이라 합니다. 일전에 한 번 인사를 드렸었는데…… 손도 잡았었죠.”

findings.current: “The manual’s a Supreme Peak martial art, and if you absorb the elixir right, it’s thirty years.”
findings.defect: The source’s traditional unit 반 갑자 is converted to a modern year count despite the established glossary term.
findings.rationale: The source says half a 갑자, and the glossary requires jiazi. Although equivalent to thirty years, replacing the unit erases the Murim register.
findings.replacement: “The manual’s a Supreme Peak martial art, and if you absorb the elixir right, it’s half a jiazi.”
findings.source: “비급은 초절정 무공이고, 영단은 잘만 흡수하면 반 갑자.”

findings.rationale: 잠룡 has the exact glossary rendering Hidden Dragon.

findings.current: “Squad Leader, please move your foot. It hurts.”
findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin’s established address for Taekyung is mistranslated.
findings.rationale: The glossary explicitly establishes 조장 as Captain in Hyuk Mujin’s dialogue.
findings.replacement: “Captain, please move your foot. It hurts.”

findings.current: The eight said to be Jin Taekyung’s subordinates advanced slowly with their backs together, whether their leader was doing anything up ahead or not.
findings.defect: The translation changes the number of Taekyung’s subordinates from nine to eight.
findings.rationale: 아홉 명 explicitly means nine people. This changes a concrete scene quantity and contradicts the squad composition established in the source.
findings.replacement: The nine said to be Jin Taekyung’s subordinates advanced slowly with their backs together, whether their leader was doing anything up ahead or not.
findings.source: 진태경의 부하라는 아홉 명은 대장이 앞에서 뭘 하건 말건 서로 등을 맞대고 느릿느릿 전진했다.

findings.current: Of the ten or so subordinates caught in One Flash, he was the only one who even left a sound.
findings.defect: The named spear technique is rendered with the wrong established name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is the named technique One Annihilation in the supplied glossary.
findings.replacement: Of the ten or so subordinates caught in One Annihilation, he was the only one who even left a sound.
findings.source: 일섬에 휘말린 십여 명의 부하 중 목소리라도 남긴 이는 그가 유일했다.

findings.defect: The dialogue uses the wrong name for Taekyung’s established spear technique.
findings.rationale: 일섬 must remain One Annihilation wherever the technique is named.

findings.current: “If you add the Three Paths Sect and Gunggwimun together, well over a hundred.”[^2]
findings.defect: Both sect names conflict with the established glossary.
findings.rationale: 삼도문 and 궁귀문 have the exact established renderings Samdo Sect and Gunggui Sect. These identities matter directly to Taekyung’s calculation of the infiltrators’ strength.
findings.replacement: “If you add the Samdo Sect and the Gunggui Sect together, well over a hundred.”
findings.source: “삼도문, 궁귀문을 합치면 백 명이 훌쩍 넘을 겁니다.”

summary: The block is broadly faithful, but several established names and titles drift from the supplied glossary. There is also a damaged squad-count reveal in Chapter 36, an incorrect subordinate count in Chapter 38, two mistranslated System attributes, and inconsistent rendering of the named technique One Annihilation.
